digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC mutation test suite
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips was permanently red because it attempted to clear a sub-task's parent field, which Data Center rejects with HTTP 400
the cell can be re-homed to clear an Epic Link on a standard-issue child instead, via the same write path that 1a9f proved works for sub-task parent clears
the re-homed cell must prime the parent through a local rebar edit so the ref is marked MANAGED, allowing should_propagate_removal to fire and propagate the clear outbound
Epic Link clear via {epic_link_field_id: None} was unverified on DC 8.17.1 until a probe confirmed it succeeds (or until existing green cells in run 30951453979 proved it)
the non-sub-task branch of set_parent lacks read-back verification to detect silent no-ops, though this is not currently masking failures

test_outbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips remains unsolvable on DC because the platform silently ignores sub-task parent writes, so it must be re-homed under a separate operator ruling rather than xfailed
